When specifying both -n and -o to int create I get this error: Mac customers/fluxia/integrations ➜  intropy int create hello-world -n INT123 -o ./domains/order-management
fetching integrio-intropy/intropy-templates@v0.1.7
error: --output ./domains/order-management is not empty (use --force to overwrite)

I dont think that should fail? We are creating a new folder, INT123 so we are not overwriting anything

The behavior you expect was actually the subject of the most recent commit on main (`e651f9c "Specifying both -n and -o should create -n subdirectory to -o"`), so either the check still runs against `-o` before joining `-n`, or your installed binary predates the fix. Let me look at the code.

72	func resolveCreateName(name, output string, sets map[string]any) (string, error) {
